channel.title: Los Angeles Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Los Angeles Times (latimes.com)

item.title: Frederick Wiseman, legendary documentarian, dies at 96
item.description: The filmmaker, who won three Emmys and an honorary Oscar for his documentary work, was known for innate curiosity covering subjects ranging from public institutions to the minutiae of human interactions.

item.title: The billionaire who wants to be California governor
item.description: Tom Steyer must solve this dilemma: How does he convince financially struggling Californians they can trust a billionaire to be their governor?

item.title: Tensions mount as LAUSD board to consider sending 3,200 notices of possible layoffs
item.description: Under an LAUSD budget proposal, layoff notices would go out to more than 3,200 but the actual number of layoffs is expected to be closer to 600.

item.title: Nearly half of L.A. County’s pavement may be unnecessary, new map finds
item.description: Researchers have released the first parcel-level analysis to map all paved surfaces across L.A. County. In particular, large parking lots are ripe for change, they say.

item.title: Robert Duvall, acting legend known for intense roles, dies at 95
item.description: Duvall did not stand out for his movie star looks but for the intensity and depth he brought to the screen in such films as "The Godfather" and "Apocalypse Now."

item.title: Epstein bought ticket to 2013 Hollywood fundraising gala years after his conviction
item.description: The disgraced financier had arranged, through a shell firm, to purchase a $15,000 ticket for Hollywood publicist Peggy Siegal to attend the 2013 event, according to bank statements and emails reviewed by The Times.

item.title: Anderson Cooper will exit '60 Minutes' to focus on family and CNN role
item.description: The CNN anchor is leaving his '60 Minutes' role to devote more time to his young children and focus on his other job.

item.title: Sheriff says Guthrie family 'cleared' as suspects in Nancy Guthrie kidnapping
item.description: As the investigation into the abduction of Nancy Guthrie enters its third week, officials said Monday they cleared direct members of her family as possible suspects.

item.title: First wave of nearly a week of rain hits Southern California. Snow expected for Mammoth, Tahoe
item.description: The Presidents Day holiday began in Southern California with bursts of rain and blasts of wind across the region, with more precipitation expected for much of the week.

item.title: L.A. Mayor Bass says LA28 head Wasserman should step down
item.description: Bass told CNN’s Dana Bash that it was “unfortunate” that the organizers of the Los Angeles Olympics are supporting Wasserman.
